## Overview

PitchBook’s API solution allows you to call specific PitchBook data into your internal business systems on demand. This flexible solution means you have access to PitchBook’s expansive database. It’s the ideal integration for CRM enrichment, allowing you to extract data on an ad-hoc basis that meets the needs of your organization.

You can explore a specific entity and retrieve valuable data, and the API solution enables you to apply specific criteria, such as location and industry, to drill down into the businesses you discover.

## Use cases

The API is a good solution if:

* Your scope and data points are subject to change frequently.
* You require a near-instant population of data.
* You perform ad-hoc research.
* You want to see past and present financial data.
* RESTful API is a system requirement.

## How the API works

**Accessing the API**

The PitchBook API is a RESTful implementation that most HTTP clients can easily access in your chosen language or via a web browser. Every call will use the same base URL: https://api.pitchbook.com

**Available data points**

The API solution offers a variety of relational endpoints, including financing details, deal stock information, as well as AI-powered VC exit predictor data. See the full list from our API Endpoints Overview document.

**Create your API connection**

To start your API connection, you will need to send a request directly to our Direct Data team through this link.

Or if you’re a PitchBook client, you can also head to the Plugins & Apps section from the My PitchBook section of the left-hand sidebar on the PitchBook Platform and choose PitchBook API.

From this section on the platform, you can test specific endpoints. This section on PitchBook also allows you to reach out to our Direct Data team to request access to the API.

# Bring trusted market data into the systems you already use

## Get the data you need, when you need it

Call down the specific data points you need for a dashboard, project, report or transaction using our API. Programatically track critical inflection points such as funding rounds, executive changes or liquidity events to stay on top of market activity.

Call data on all PitchBook entity types including deals, investors, funds, people, limited partners and service providers.

## Customized solutions for the way you work

Our team of experts will work with you to ensure your organization can bridge any gap of understanding to place insights and data where they can make the biggest business impact. Available data for each entity type is conveniently packaged across several endpoints so you can get all the data you need—and none that you don’t.

## Streamline your operations

Our RESTful API utilizes JSON and is system agnostic, so you can integrate it into custom applications and CRMs to bring the industry’s best data directly into your workflow. Provide your team with the right data to more easily analyze trends and build predictive models—right in your existing systems.

### FAQs about PitchBook

Is PitchBook worth it?

Our full-featured platform and interconnected datasets mean your dollar goes further with us. Discover private market analysis and emerging technology research—including direct access to our analyst team for consultation. Plus, enjoy complimentary access to our desktop offering, PitchBook Mobile app, and Excel and PowerPoint plugins, as well as our Chrome extension.



How much does PitchBook cost?

While PitchBook is geared toward investment professionals, anyone can find value in our platform’s extensive capital market data, research, and insights. Pricing options vary depending on how many seats you need and your firm type. Another primary consideration is whether you’re interested in additional premium offerings, such as Direct Data or CRM Integration. Find out what the cost for you might look like by getting in touch with a representative today.



**Can individuals use PitchBook?**

PitchBook is geared towards sophisticated investment professionals, but almost anyone could find value in our premium, hard-to-find data covering the private, public, and credit market landscape. If you operate in any of these spaces, PitchBook might be right for you.

Datasets include:

* Private Equity Deals and Manager Data
* Venture Capital Deals and Manager Data
* Strategic Merger & Acquisition Deals and Acquirers Data
* Limited Partner (LP) Data
* Public Company Fundamental Data
* Service Provider Data
* People Data
* Patents Data
* Hedge Fund Data
* Leveraged Loan News
* Analytics
* Index Data.

Get in touch with a representative today to see how PitchBook can help you.
